_about: How things are named (docs/lore/README.md; decision 366): forms by how a name came (holder, deed, maker), filled from {holder}, {thing}, {deed} and {maker}, and lore's word for a thing where it differs from the item's own. Read by Lore.name_forms, thing_word and render_name; only agreed ones count. Until F1 is answered, the holder form is the only one (Jeff: for now "Wren's Dagger" is sufficient); agreed on his word.
